aggregations.adjacency_matrix: Makes a bucket for each named filter and for each pair of filters whose documents overlap.
aggregations.auto_date_histogram: Groups documents by date into about a target number of buckets, choosing the interval itself.
aggregations.avg: Averages the values of a numeric field.
aggregations.avg_bucket: Averages a metric across the buckets of a sibling aggregation.
aggregations.boxplot: Computes the minimum, maximum, median and quartiles of a numeric field for a box plot.
aggregations.bucket_script: Computes a new value in each bucket with a script over that bucket's metrics.
aggregations.bucket_selector: Keeps only the buckets for which a script over their metrics returns true.
aggregations.bucket_sort: Sorts the buckets of the parent aggregation and can keep only some of them.
aggregations.cardinality: Counts the approximate number of distinct values of a field.
aggregations.children: Makes a bucket of the child documents that belong to the documents in the current bucket.
aggregations.composite: Pages through the combinations of values from several sources, one page of buckets at a time.
aggregations.cumulative_cardinality: Gives each histogram bucket the running count of distinct values seen so far.
aggregations.cumulative_sum: Gives each histogram bucket the running total of a metric.
aggregations.date_histogram: Groups documents into buckets of a fixed date or time interval.
aggregations.date_range: Groups documents into buckets of the date ranges you set.
aggregations.derivative: Computes how much a metric changes from one histogram bucket to the next.
aggregations.diversified_sampler: Limits the aggregation to a sample of the top-scoring documents, with a cap on documents per value of a field.
aggregations.extended_stats: Computes the count, min, max, average, sum, variance and standard deviation of a numeric field.
aggregations.extended_stats_bucket: Computes extended statistics of a metric across the buckets of a sibling aggregation.
aggregations.filter: Makes one bucket of the documents that match a query.
aggregations.filters: Makes one bucket per query, each holding the documents that match it.
aggregations.geo_bounds: Computes the smallest rectangle that holds every geopoint of a field.
aggregations.geo_centroid: Computes the center of the geopoints of a field.
aggregations.geo_distance: Groups documents into rings of distance around a point.
aggregations.geohash_grid: Groups geopoints into the cells of a geohash grid.
aggregations.geotile_grid: Groups geopoints into the cells of a map tile grid.
aggregations.global: Makes one bucket of every document in the searched indexes, whatever the query.
aggregations.histogram: Groups documents into buckets of a fixed numeric interval.
aggregations.ip_range: Groups documents into buckets of IP address ranges.
aggregations.matrix_stats: Computes statistics, including covariance and correlation, over several numeric fields.
aggregations.max: Finds the highest value of a numeric field.
aggregations.max_bucket: Finds the bucket with the highest value of a metric in a sibling aggregation.
aggregations.median_absolute_deviation: Measures how widely the values of a numeric field spread around their median.
aggregations.min: Finds the lowest value of a numeric field.
aggregations.min_bucket: Finds the bucket with the lowest value of a metric in a sibling aggregation.
aggregations.missing: Makes one bucket of the documents that have no value for a field.
aggregations.moving_avg: Smooths a metric with a moving average over a sliding window of histogram buckets.
aggregations.moving_fn: Runs a script over a sliding window of histogram buckets, such as a moving average or sum.
aggregations.moving_percentiles: Computes percentiles over a sliding window of histogram buckets from each bucket's percentiles metric.
aggregations.multi_terms: Groups documents by the combinations of values of several fields.
aggregations.nested: Aggregates the objects of a nested field as documents of their own.
aggregations.normalize: Rescales a metric of each histogram bucket, for example to its percent of the total.
aggregations.parent: Makes a bucket of the parent documents that the documents in the current bucket belong to.
aggregations.percentile_ranks: Gives the percent of values of a numeric field that fall at or below each given value.
aggregations.percentiles: Computes percentiles of the values of a numeric field.
aggregations.percentiles_bucket: Computes percentiles of a metric across the buckets of a sibling aggregation.
aggregations.range: Groups documents into buckets of the numeric ranges you set.
aggregations.rare_terms: Finds the values of a field that appear in only a few documents.
aggregations.rate: Computes a rate, such as a sum or a count per time unit, in each date histogram bucket.
aggregations.reverse_nested: Steps back from nested objects to their parent documents inside a nested aggregation.
aggregations.sampler: Limits the aggregation to a sample of the top-scoring documents on each shard.
aggregations.scripted_metric: Computes a metric with scripts for its init, map, combine and reduce steps.
aggregations.serial_diff: Subtracts from each histogram bucket's metric the value from a set number of buckets earlier.
aggregations.significant_terms: Finds the values of a field that are unusually common in the matching documents compared with all documents.
aggregations.significant_text: Finds the words of a text field that are unusually common in the matching documents.
aggregations.stats: Computes the count, min, max, average and sum of a numeric field.
aggregations.stats_bucket: Computes the count, min, max, average and sum of a metric across the buckets of a sibling aggregation.
aggregations.sum: Adds up the values of a numeric field.
aggregations.sum_bucket: Adds up a metric across the buckets of a sibling aggregation.
aggregations.t_test: Runs a t-test to check whether two groups of values have different means.
aggregations.terms: Groups documents by the values of a field, most frequent first.
aggregations.top_hits: Returns the top documents of each bucket.
aggregations.value_count: Counts the values of a field across the documents.
aggregations.variable_width_histogram: Groups numeric values into a target number of buckets whose widths follow the data.
aggregations.weighted_avg: Averages a numeric field, weighting each value by another field.

queries.agentic: Takes a question in plain language and has a configured agent plan and run the search.
queries.bool: Combines queries with must, should, must_not and filter clauses.
queries.boosting: Returns documents that match the positive query and lowers the score of those that also match the negative query.
queries.combined_fields: Searches several text fields as if their contents were one field.
queries.common: Searches text while giving less weight to very frequent words (deprecated).
queries.constant_score: Runs a filter query and gives every matching document the same score.
queries.dis_max: Returns documents that match any of its queries, scored by the best-matching one plus a tie breaker for the others.
queries.distance_feature: Raises the score of documents whose date or geopoint is closer to a given origin.
queries.exists: Matches documents that hold an indexed value for a field.
queries.field_masking_span: Lets a span query on one field join span queries on another field by reporting that other field's name.
queries.function_score: Changes the scores of a query's documents with functions such as field values, decay curves or random numbers.
queries.geo_bounding_box: Matches documents whose geopoint lies inside a rectangle.
queries.geo_distance: Matches documents whose geopoint lies within a given distance of a point.
queries.geo_polygon: Matches documents whose geopoint lies inside a polygon.
queries.geo_shape: Matches documents whose geopoint or geoshape intersects, contains, lies within or is disjoint from a given shape.
queries.has_child: Returns parent documents whose child documents match a query.
queries.has_parent: Returns child documents whose parent document matches a query.
queries.hybrid: Combines the scores of several queries, such as a keyword query and a neural query, into one score per document.
queries.ids: Returns the documents with the given IDs.
queries.knn: Finds the k nearest neighbors of a vector in a knn_vector field.
queries.more_like_this: Finds documents similar to the given text or documents.
queries.multi_match: Runs a match query across several fields.
queries.nested: Searches nested objects as separate documents and returns the parent documents that match.
queries.neural: Turns text or an image into a vector with a machine learning model and finds the nearest vectors.
queries.neural_sparse: Searches a sparse vector field with weighted tokens made from the text by a sparse encoding model or an analyzer.
queries.parent_id: Returns the child documents joined to a given parent document.
queries.percolate: Finds the stored queries that match a given document.
queries.query_string: Searches with the Lucene query string syntax, including field names, operators and wildcards.
queries.rank_feature: Raises the score of documents by the value of a rank_feature or rank_features field.
queries.script: Keeps the documents for which a script returns true.
queries.script_score: Scores the documents of a query with a script.
queries.simple_query_string: Searches with a simpler query string syntax that skips invalid parts instead of failing.
queries.sltr: Scores documents with a trained Learning to Rank model or feature set (Learning to Rank plugin).
queries.span_containing: Returns the spans of the big query that contain a span of the little query.
queries.span_first: Matches spans that end within the first positions of a field.
queries.span_multi: Wraps a term, prefix, wildcard, fuzzy, regexp or range query so it can serve as a span query.
queries.span_near: Matches spans that are near each other, within a given distance and optionally in order.
queries.span_not: Removes the spans that overlap the spans of another query.
queries.span_or: Matches the spans of any of its clauses.
queries.span_within: Returns the spans of the little query that lie inside a span of the big query.
queries.type: Matches documents of a given mapping type (a legacy query).
queries.wrapper: Runs a query given as a Base64-encoded string.
queries.xy_shape: Matches documents whose xy point or xy shape relates to a given Cartesian shape.
